title: Fraction charts agree on overlaps and affine base refinements
statement: Let f:W→T be a scheme morphism, A a quasi-coherent graded commutative O_T-algebra, L an invertible O_W-module, and psi_n:f^*A_n→L^n preserve the tensor unit and products. Suppose for every affine V, positive d and a in A_d(V) a chart q_(V,d,a):G_(V,d,a)→Spec A(V)_(a),0 satisfies the homogeneous fraction equation of [def-trf-line-proj-fraction-chart-data]. The chart maps composed to relative Proj agree on pairwise intersections, including unequal positive degrees and different affine base opens. For every affine C contained in V, G_(C,d,a|C)=G_(V,d,a) intersect f^{-1}C, and the two local Proj maps on this source agree under (gradeIso C)^(-1) followed by localTransition(C,V) followed by gradeIso V. Thus the given family satisfies LineProjBaseRefinement without any special choice of its charts.

proof.text: On a local frame open B inside f^{-1}V, the coefficient construction gives a ring map phi:A(V) to O(B). If psi(a) generates then phi(a) is a unit and the image of the irrelevant ideal is the unit ideal. Mathlib constructs a morphism B to Proj A(V). Its restriction to the a-chart pulls back b/a^m to the scalar satisfying rho(b/a^m)phi(a)^m=phi(b), as follows from the localization relation and the standard chart description. Cancel the tensor-power frame to identify this with the given chart using fraction uniqueness. Every pair of charts over V therefore agrees locally with the same Proj morphism, for arbitrary positive degrees.

proof.text: For affine C contained in V, naturality of the normalized tensor-pullback adjunction and of psi identifies image restrictions. The germ-basis criterion identifies G_{a|C} with G_a intersect f^{-1}C. The graded restriction A(V) to A(C) induces a homogeneous-localization homomorphism carrying b/a^m to b|C/(a|C)^m. Compose its Spec map with q_{C,a|C}; the transported fraction equation is exactly that of q_{V,a} on the smaller open. Fraction uniqueness proves equality. Standard away-chart naturality proves equality after inclusion into Proj A(V); gradeIso_naturality gives the specified localTransition expression.

proof.text: At any point of an arbitrary-base overlap choose an affine C inside V intersect V'. Restrict both homogeneous sections to C. The base-refinement equalities identify the original relative chart maps with these C-charts, and the same-base result identifies the C-charts on their intersection. Scheme morphisms agree locally, hence on the whole overlap. Empty opens and exponent zero require no exceptions.

theorem lineProj_fraction_compatibility {W T : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ T)
    (A : RelativeProjAlgebra T) (L : W.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (ψ : ∀ n : ℕ, (tensorPullback f).obj (A.piece n) ⟶ L.tensorPow n)
    (hunit : ∀ (V : T.Opens) (r : Γ(T, V)),
      lineProjImage f A L ψ V 0 (A.graded.unit.val.app (op V) (unitSectionsEquiv V r)) =
        unitSectionsEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f.app V r))
    (hmul : ∀ (V : T.Opens) (m n : ℕ) (a : Γ(A.piece m, V))
        (b : Γ(A.piece n, V)),
      lineProjImage f A L ψ V (m + n) (A.graded.mul m n V a b) =
        (L.tensorPowAddIso m n).inv.app (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
          (tmulSection (lineProjImage f A L ψ V m a) (lineProjImage f A L ψ V n b)))
    (q : ∀ (V : T.affineOpens) (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (a : Γ(A.piece d, V.1)),
      LineProjChart f A L ψ V d a)
    (hq : ∀ (V : T.affineOpens) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (a : Γ(A.piece d, V.1)),
      LineProjFractionFormula f A L ψ V d a
        (lineProjGeneratorOpen f A L ψ V d a) inf_le_left (q V d hd a)) :
    (∀ (V V' : T.affineOpens) (d e : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (he : 0 < e)
        (a : Γ(A.piece d, V.1)) (b : Γ(A.piece e, V'.1)),
        W.homOfLE (inf_le_left :
            lineProjGeneratorOpen f A L ψ V d a ⊓ lineProjGeneratorOpen f A L ψ V' e b ≤
              lineProjGeneratorOpen f A L ψ V d a) ≫
            lineProjChartToRelative f A L ψ V d hd a (q V d hd a) =
          W.homOfLE inf_le_right ≫
            lineProjChartToRelative f A L ψ V' e he b (q V' e he b)) ∧
      LineProjBaseRefinement f A L ψ q
